The '''16th Academy Awards''' were held on March 2, 1944, to honor the films of [[1943 in film|1943]]. This was the first Oscar ceremony held at a large public venue, [[Grauman's Chinese Theatre]], and the first ceremony without a banquet as part of the festivities.<ref name="Oscars '43 Notes"/><ref>{{cite news |title=History of the Oscars Presentation |url=https://www.oscars.org/sites/oscars/files/88aa_presentation_history.pdf |access-date=May 3, 2023 |work=Oscars.org}}</ref> The ceremony was broadcast locally on [[KFWB]], and internationally by [[CBS Radio]] via [[Shortwave radio|shortwave]]. [[Jack Benny]] hosted the event, which lasted one hour and 42 minutes.<ref name="Cinema Sight">{{cite web |url=http://cinemasight.com/awards-history/16th-academy-awards-1943/16th-academy-awards-1943-the-ceremony/ |title=16th Academy Awards (1943): The Ceremony |date=April 22, 2018 |edition=Revised |access-date=March 14, 2023}}</ref> This was the first ceremony to welcome admissions from the general public.<ref name="Oscars '43 Notes">
{{cite book |last1=Wallechinsky |first1=David |last2=Wallace |first2=Irving |date=1975 |title=The People's Almanac |url=https://archive.org/details/peoplesalmanac00wall/page/836/mode/2up |location=Garden City, New York |publisher=Doubleday & Company, Inc. |page=836 |isbn=0-385-04060-1}}</ref>

For the first time, winners for [[Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor|Best Supporting Actor]] and [[Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress|Best Supporting Actress]] were awarded full-size statuettes, instead of smaller-sized awards mounted on a plaque.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.bbc.com/culture/article/20180305-strange-tales-of-the-vanished-oscars |title=Strange tales of the vanished Oscars|date=March 6, 2018 }}</ref> This was the last year until [[82nd Academy Awards|2009]] to have 10 nominations for Best Picture; ''[[The Ox-Bow Incident]]'' is, {{as of|2025|lc=y}}, the last film to be nominated solely in that category.

''[[For Whom the Bell Tolls (film)|For Whom the Bell Tolls]]'' was the third film to receive [[List of films with all four Academy Award acting nominations|nominations in all four acting categories]]. This was the first year in which each acting category had at least one nominee from a color film.

The ''[[Tom and Jerry]]'' cartoon series won its first Oscar this year for ''[[The Yankee Doodle Mouse]]''; it would go on to win another six Oscars, including three in a row over the next three years, from a total of 13 nominations.

=== Awards ===
Nominees were announced on February 6, 1944. Winners are listed first and highlighted in boldface.<ref name="Oscars1944">{{cite web |url=http://www.oscars.org/oscars/ceremonies/1944 |title=The 16th Academy Awards (1944) Nominees and Winners |access-date=October 13, 2013 |publisher=Oscars.org ([[Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences]]) |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131014001522/http://www.oscars.org/awards/academyawards/legacy/ceremony/16th-winners.html |archive-date=October 14, 2013 |url-status=live}}</ref>
